name: Google Search
role: primary Google SERP and competitor capture
notes: Use Chrome manually. Capture positions 1-10, then inspect page 2 when needed.

name: Google Ads Keyword Planner
role: Google market volume and advertiser competition
notes: Average monthly searches depend on location, language, network and selected month range.

name: Google Search Console
role: first-party queries, impressions, clicks and position
notes: Measures this property only. It is not total market search volume.

name: Google Trends
notes: Normalized 0-100 index; keep separate from Google Ads volume.

name: Bing Webmaster Keyword Research
role: secondary volume, trend and top-URL cross-check
notes: Useful cross-check; do not substitute Bing volume for Google volume.

name: YouTube Search
notes: Use for phrasing, demonstrations and frequently asked follow-up questions.

name: Reddit Search
notes: Research source, not a Google-volume source.

name: Quora Search
role: English question formulations and answer gaps
notes: Research source, not a Google-ranking proxy.

name: 知乎搜索
notes: Use for depth comparison and reader language.

name: 小红书搜索
notes: Use for question wording and missing practical details.

name: 微信搜一搜
notes: Use for comparable articles and terminology; do not treat platform rank as Google rank.

name: 百度搜索/百度知道
role: Mainland Chinese terminology and question coverage
notes: Useful for wording and topic discovery; volume is not Google volume.

name: 公开网页搜索（非 Google SERP）
role: 竞品/行业来源发现，不用于排名判断
notes: 用于定位法律文章、行业办理资料与官方来源；不能证明 Google 排名、前两页覆盖或搜索量。
